en: Idle tasks can now select an execution account and apply account, model and reasoning settings while another task runs. The account controls no longer inherit another task’s busy state.

Account switching checks the selected task instead of locking all tasks. The running task and its output remain intact; continuing another task still uses the existing execution queue. Running, stopping and unresolved tasks retain their switch protection.
zh: 其他会话运行时，空闲会话现在可以选择执行账号，并应用账号、模型与思考等级设置；账号控制区不再误用其他会话的忙碌状态。
后台切换账号只检查目标会话，保留正在运行的任务及输出连接；继续其他任务仍沿用现有执行队列。正在运行、停止中和状态未核对的会话继续保留切换保护。
